prompt: Rendered as a pencil sketch with light color wash, the scene captures a village market at dawn. On the far left stands a tall wooden stall draped in faded blue canvas. Next to it sits an old woman in a grey shawl, her back slightly hunched. A woven basket rests beside her knees, overflowing with green apples. A young boy in a striped shirt points eagerly at the fruit, his finger extended toward the produce. The old woman looks down at him with a gentle smile, acknowledging his interest. In the center foreground, a large clay pot holds fresh milk, its surface reflecting the pale morning sky. A brown goat stands next to the pot, sniffing curiously at the rim. A farmer in muddy boots holds the goat’s rope tightly, preventing it from tipping the vessel. Behind them, a stack of yellow pumpkins rises high, creating a vibrant backdrop. A stray cat with white paws sleeps atop the highest pumpkin, curled into a tight ball. To the right, a vendor in a bright orange turban arranges bundles of dried herbs on a low table. A customer in a long black coat examines the herbs closely, holding a small bunch up to the light. The vendor gestures with an open hand, explaining the quality of the spices. A red bicycle leans against the table leg, its front wheel slightly bent. A child in a pink dress rides a tricycle past the bicycle, pedaling slowly across the cobblestones. Above the scene, three colorful flags hang from a rope strung between two posts, fluttering gently in the breeze. A rooster with bright plumage perches on the lower post, crowing into the quiet air. Near the right edge, a stone well with an iron handle stands unused, its bucket resting on the ground. A man in a blue cap fills a jug from a nearby water tap, his posture relaxed. A dog with floppy ears lies near the man’s feet, watching the water flow. There is no electricity or modern wiring visible in the structures. There is no plastic packaging or synthetic materials among the goods. There is no vehicle with an engine present in the marketplace.
